intervals.label: operation at the CERN Neutrino Platform
intervals.note: The DUNE site states the first prototype started taking data in September 2018; no end date for ProtoDUNE-SP running could be sourced, so the terminal interval is left open (ontology §4 allows this with confidence "uncertain").
intervals.quote: The first started taking data in September 2018 and the second is under construction.

name: ProtoDUNE-SP
notes: The liquid argon mass (about 0.8 kt in the cryostat) could not be sourced from any page fetched in this session and is left null.

placements.note: Installed in the CERN Neutrino Platform test-beam hall (EHN1) in the CERN North Area.
placements.quote: It is installed at the CERN Neutrino Platform in a specially-constructed beam that delivers charged pions, kaons, protons, muons and electrons with momenta in the range 0.3 GeV/c to 7 GeV/c.

drift_field.quote: Under the nominal electric field of 500 V/cm, the maximum electron drift time is 2.25 ms.

drift_length.note: The DUNE FD TDR Vol. I instead states that ProtoDUNE-SP "has the same 3.5 m maximum drift length as the full SP module"; the detector paper is preferred here.
drift_length.quote: the 3.6 m drift distance in ProtoDUNE-SP makes higher demands on argon purity

phase.quote: single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber

target_medium.quote: single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber

description.quote: with three APAs forming an anode plane opposite to the cathode on either side
description.value: Full-size DUNE APAs, three per anode plane, reading out the two drift volumes

description.quote: This paper describes the beam line, the time projection chamber, the photon detectors, the cosmic-ray tagger, the signal processing and particle reconstruction.
description.value: External cosmic-ray tagger used together with the beam instrumentation

summary.plain: A full-height prototype of the DUNE far detector, built at CERN and exposed to a test beam of known particles from 2018. It showed that the design works before the real detectors were built in South Dakota.
summary.technical: Single-phase LArTPC prototype at the CERN Neutrino Platform (EHN1) with a 7.2 × 6.0 × 6.9 m³ active volume, 3.6 m drift at 500 V/cm, full-size DUNE APAs, photon detectors and a cosmic-ray tagger, in a 0.3-7 GeV/c tagged charged-particle beam from 2018.
